title: Convert or split a TTTR file
text: This tool converts a TTTR file to another format, or splits it into parts by time or by photon count. Start with a demonstration stream, then your own.

title: Start with a demonstration stream
text: Load example generates a deterministic demonstration stream (two detectors, plenty of photons) in the settings cache and selects it as the input.

title: Choose the input
text: Pick the photon stream to split in the Input table -- the workspace's TTTR files and the streams of .pto containers; files dropped on the ChiSurf window land there. Load example already added a deterministic demonstration measurement.

await.hint: Pick a photon stream in the Input table.

title: Choose the output
text: Press the browse button beside Output folder and select a destination.

await.hint: Press the browse button beside Output folder.

title: Set formats and split options
text: Choose the input container and the output container, then the chunk size and binning. Disable Split into files for a single output. Keep original protects the source.

title: Convert or split
text: Press Convert / Split when the input and options are ready. The guide waits for this action; progress and status report whether the operation completes successfully.

await.hint: Press Convert / Split in the Input / Output panel.
